summary: Object constructor for a DirectX texture/surface from a source descriptor (a2). Stores the vtable, calls the embedded sub-object array constructor (256 elements of 16 bytes at this+0x30), copies format metadata and the 6-dword dimension header, selects a render-temp data pointer, stores mip stride (a3 >> 3) and the mip-level flag (a3 != 0), converts a packed ARGB color to normalized float RGBA, and for indexed formats (IDs 40 and 41) initializes the 256-entry palette from source palette data, or fills it opaque white when no palette data is supplied. Finally it computes dimension deltas and, when the mip flag is set, advances the mip-origin accumulator by delta * stride for the next level. Returns this.
